text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer, multi-paragraph organization with introduction, three body sections, and conclusion","quality":"text organization","description":"The essay shows clearer overall structure and progression of ideas across paragraphs."},{"evidence":"repeated connectors like 'The first reason,' 'The second reason,' 'The third reason,' and 'In conclusion'","quality":"cohesion","description":"The essay uses more explicit transition language to link sections and signal the argument's flow."},{"evidence":"expanded explanations of each reason with multiple supporting details","quality":"development","description":"The essay develops its points more fully instead of relying on brief, single-step examples."},{"evidence":"phrases such as 'you never know what someone is going through' and 'young kids will automatically learn from you'","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay gives more explanatory commentary that clarifies why the examples matter."},{"evidence":"embedded example about helping a crying classmate and a second example about sharing notes","quality":"supporting evidence","description":"The essay includes more concrete illustrative examples to back up its claims."},{"evidence":"sentences like 'You can be seen as a person with good characters and manners'","quality":"word choice","description":"The essay uses a somewhat broader and more varied vocabulary than the other essay."}]}
